children: On November 23, 2026, Virtuix Holdings received notice from Nasdaq that its stock had closed below $1.00 per share for 30 consecutive business days, failing Nasdaq Listing Rule 5450(a)(1). The company has until May 24, 2027, to regain compliance by maintaining a closing bid price of at least $1.00 for 10 consecutive business days; the notice does not immediately affect its listing. The company also has a separate Nasdaq market-value compliance deadline of March 29, 2027.
